events.description:

An event that starts as a steady state ride but builds towards the end with an optional power pyramid or intervals.

EVENT DYNAMICS

Power - 2.3 > 2.7 wkg but expect the event to finish with an average power around 2.5wkg based on a 75kg rider

events.name: GXY RIDE THE RAINBOW
events.summary: Part of the RIDE THE RAINBOW group of workout events Tuesday and Thursday at the same time
events.description:
Part of the RIDE THE RAINBOW group of workout events Tuesday and Thursday at the same time

This event is a workout ride based on your individual Functional Threshold Power (FTP).  This is not a group ride and has no draft effect.  The coloured power zones will be called out by the ride leader during the event.  Expect them to fluctuate throughout the rainbow colours.

Once you understand the concept of how this event works, you will find that it is fun, engaging and a tough workout all-in-one

EVENT DYNAMICS

Category	- E
Power 	- 1.0 > 5.0wkg wholly dependent on your own FTP rating
Draft	- No
Sweeper 	- No
